privileged_info_for_vlm: The required values are: BASE_JOINT (minStop: -1.5708, maxStop: 1.5708, motor maxVelocity: 1.57) and SHOULDER_JOINT (minStop: -0.7854, maxStop: 1.5708, motor maxVelocity: 1.57).
